author: mfhansen
title: LLM accuracy tests fail with TypeError: genai_gen_text() got an unexpected keyword argument 'context'
signature: typeerror genai_gen_text got an unexpected keyword argument context|Dependencies

failed_jobs.name: LLM accuracy iGPU tests / LLM accuracy GPU tests
failed_jobs.symptom: All 4 GPU accuracy_conformance test cases fail with TypeError: genai_gen_text() got an unexpected keyword argument 'context'

failed_jobs.name: LLM accuracy CPU tests / LLM accuracy CPU tests
failed_jobs.symptom: All 4 CPU accuracy_conformance test cases fail identically with TypeError: genai_gen_text() got an unexpected keyword argument 'context'

TypeError: genai_gen_text() got an unexpected keyword argument 'context'
root_cause: The tests/llm/requirements.txt pulls the whowhatbench package directly from the openvino.genai master branch (git+https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino.genai.git#subdirectory=tools/who_what_benchmark) with no pin. An upstream change to whowhatbench's text_evaluator.py now calls the model's generation function (genai_gen_text) with an extra 'context' keyword argument that the installed generation-function implementation does not accept, breaking every accuracy_conformance test on both CPU and GPU. This failure is unrelated to the merge-queue PR itself (PR #39512 only edits a benchmarks CSV file) and is purely an unpinned-dependency drift issue; it has recurred 3 times since 2026-11-05 across unrelated PRs, confirming it is a persistent, not transient, dependency-version mismatch.
reproduction_steps: Install tests/llm/requirements.txt (which pulls whowhatbench from openvino.genai@master) against the current genai_gen_text generation-function implementation, then run: python3 -m pytest tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py -k CPU --tb native. The TypeError reproduces immediately on the first test case.
recommended_actions: Pin tests/llm/requirements.txt's whowhatbench dependency to a known-good commit/tag of openvino.genai instead of tracking master, or update the repo's genai_gen_text() implementation to accept the new 'context' keyword argument used by whowhatbench.text_evaluator._generate_data.

Add a compatibility shim/kwarg (**kwargs or an explicit context=None parameter) to genai_gen_text() in tests/llm (or the openvino_genai helper it wraps) so new optional arguments from whowhatbench do not break the test suite.
Coordinate with the openvino.genai / whowhatbench maintainers to confirm the intended signature change and align both repos before merging.
prevention_strategies: Avoid unpinned 'git+https://...@master' dependencies for test-only packages that are developed in lockstep with code under test; pin to a tag/commit and bump deliberately via CI, or add a contract test that fails fast with a clear message when the upstream function signature changes.
historical_context: This exact signature has now been seen 3 times (first seen 2026-11-05T06:17:40Z, most recent prior occurrence 2026-11-06T18:21:38Z on run 42251178965), always on unrelated PRs, confirming the break stems from an upstream whowhatbench update rather than any merge-queue PR content.
